summary: Corteva announced the expiration and final results of private exchange offers by its subsidiary Vylor Inc. for any and all outstanding EIDP notes: 2.300% senior notes due 2030, 5.125% due 2032, and 4.800% due 2033, plus consent solicitations. Eligible holders could exchange EIDP notes for corresponding new Vylor notes. The filing excerpt states no price, premium, or completion levels; Corteva common stock trades on NYSE under CTVA. The mechanics involve a private exchange relying on holder eligibility, with consents potentially amending indenture terms. Watch final participation, proration caps, and any residual EIDP notes outstanding for refinancing and covenant risk.
